newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil drills dry well in Norwegian Sea.
newsitem.headline: Statoil drills dry well in Norwegian Sea.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) has completed exploration well 6610/2-1 S in the Norwegian Sea off the coast of Nordland province in northern Norway, the Oil Directorate said on Wednesday.

The well, drilled to a depth of 2,558 metres below sea level, showed only traces of hydrocarbon but provided valuable information of the geology in the exploration area known as Nordland III, the directorate said.

Under licence 177, blocks 6610/2 and 6610/3 were awarded in Norway's 13th concession round in 1991. Partners in the blocks are Statoil, as operator with 50 percent, British Petroleum with 30 percent and Saga Petroleum with 20 percent.
